answer: Each epoch, an agent earns only if it posts a verifiable delay function output seeded by the fresh beacon: about an hour of strictly serial hashing that no parallel trick can shorten, yet anyone checks it in milliseconds. One honest agent burns one core for that hour. A farm of fifty clones must keep fifty cores busy, so its cost grows in lockstep with its headcount. Like water carving karst into a canyon, the work is slow and cannot be rushed, and a missing proof is a clear signal that the identity was never really there.
